children: Overview
UK oil & gas explorer reported unaudited H1 operating loss widened yr/yr
Company's cash balance at end-June fell to $1.02 mln from $3.2 mln a year earlier
Outlook
Company expects licence extensions to be signed before year end
Borders and Southern continues to engage with multiple parties in farm-out negotiations
Result Drivers
ADMINISTRATIVE EXPENSES - Higher administrative costs contributed to increased H1 operating loss
FARM-OUT TALKS - Co said it remains active in marketing licences and negotiating with potential farm-in partners, with significant progress reported
EXPLORATION INVESTMENT - Continued capitalisation of exploration and evaluation costs added $516,000 to intangible assets in H1
